purpose: Prove the complete bounded Horizon witness (HTTP readiness, login, project context, panels, native resource visibility, O3K independence, and recovery after restart) against the pinned unmodified client before spending another immutable release candidate.

harness_change_required_by_this_run.classification: harness configuration defect, not an O3K defect
harness_change_required_by_this_run.why: OPENSTACK_API_VERSIONS['compute'] selects the novaclient v2 client family, not a Nova REST microversion. Upstream Horizon 2026.1 defaults it to 2 (openstack_dashboard/defaults.py:341-346) and Horizon's own registry rejects other values (openstack_dashboard/api/base.py:104-116), which produced '2.1 is not a supported API version for the compute service, choices are: 2, 1.1, 2'.

post_fix_pagination_verification.note: Direct probes on the same runtime after the bounded pagination fix, using the exact query strings the pinned client sent.

captured_pair_now_terminates.page_1: GET /v2.0/networks?limit=21&sort_key=id&sort_dir=asc&shared=True -> the network, networks_links carries only rel=self
captured_pair_now_terminates.marker_follow_up: GET /v2.0/networks?sort_key=id&sort_dir=asc&shared=True&marker=01a0c884-805f-7231-a08d-00a7f5297eb2&limit=21 -> {"networks":[]}, so the client's marker probe ends the traversal instead of repeating the page

compute_collection.page_1: GET /v2.1/{project_id}/servers/detail?limit=1 -> one server plus a rel=next link whose marker is that server's id
compute_collection.follow_up: GET /v2.1/{project_id}/servers/detail?limit=1&marker=<page 1 id> -> the remaining server and no rel=next link (final page)

post_fix_pagination_verification.non_paginating_clients: a collection request without limit keeps its previous response shape and gains no link array

residual_client_observations.observation: Recoverable error: 2.1 is not a supported API version for the compute service, choices are: 2, 1.1, 2
residual_client_observations.status: fixed in tests/pp4-core-campaign/horizon-witness.sh; no O3K change made or required

residual_client_observations.observation: Recoverable error: Endless pagination loop detected, aborting
residual_client_observations.why_it_loops: Both responses returned the identical single network with no networks_links and no links key. The client re-requests with marker=<last id of the page>; a conformant service answers that follow-up with zero resources, which terminates the loop, but O3K ignores both limit and marker and repeats the page, so the guard fires.
residual_client_observations.same_class_on_compute: GET /v2.1/{project_id}/servers/detail?limit=1&marker=009c1501-28ff-5f3f-a5b4-a4602d3a9a41 returned both servers with no servers_links; the pinned client did not loop because the project held fewer servers than its page size
residual_client_observations.status: fixed on this branch and verified on the live witness; bounded to the Nova and Neutron collections the accepted journey exercises, with regression tests
residual_client_observations.verified_behavior: the captured pair now terminates with an empty follow-up page, a page is never repeated, and a collection request without limit keeps its previous response shape

residual_client_observations.observation: GET /v2.1/{project_id}/limits?reserved=1 -> HTTP 404, novaclient.exceptions.NotFound, logged as 'Failed to retrieve quota information'
residual_client_observations.owner: O3K, outside the accepted bounded witness bar

residual_client_observations.classification: O3K endpoint gap, recoverable; already a tracked candidate
residual_client_observations.owner: O3K, outside the accepted bounded witness bar

residual_client_observations.observation: GET /v2.0/floatingips?... -> HTTP 503 'floating IP service is not configured'
residual_client_observations.owner: O3K deployment profile (the floating-IP service is not configured in this TestLab profile)

Classified as not required by the accepted bounded witness; the 503-versus-404 shape is recorded for a separate compatibility question and was not changed in this slice.

residual_client_observations.observation: oslo_policy warnings stating 'The token used to make the request was domain scoped'
residual_client_observations.classification: client-side policy-context warning, not an O3K response
residual_client_observations.counter_evidence: GET /v3/auth/tokens for the scoped token returns keys [catalog, expires_at, issued_at, methods, project, roles, user]: the project scope is present and no domain or system scope is present, so O3K does not report the session as domain scoped

instances_panel_call_graph_probes.note: Direct probes with a project-scoped token against the same runtime, completing the call graph the pinned client exercised while loading the Instances and Overview panels.
instances_panel_call_graph_probes.note_on_project_root: The catalog advertises the compute endpoint as /v2.1/{project_id} (legacy Nova v2-style catalog), so an endpoint-root probe cannot resolve. Both pinned clients (novaclient and the openstack CLI) tolerate the 404 and proceed with the configured microversion, and no error was logged for it. Recorded as an observed bounded deviation with no observed impact, not a defect proven by this run.

conclusion: The bounded Horizon witness now passes end to end against the pinned unmodified client, including the Instances panel that previously answered HTTP 500, native resource visibility, O3K independence from Horizon, and recovery after the witness is re-created. The collection-pagination defect (issue 1032) is fixed on this branch and verified against the exact captured request pair, so the client's pagination guard is silent. PP.4 Core is still not certifiable from this file: it is a development confirmation on a hand-swapped runtime, and the three remaining client observations are tracked recoverable gaps outside the accepted witness bar (/limits and os-simple-tenant-usage reads, and the unconfigured floating-IP service). Final evidence must come from the public successor candidate on a fresh host.
secrets: No credentials recorded. The Horizon session key used by the witness is a clearly non-secret local literal, and no token, password, or signing key appears in this file.
